business.name: Vanguard Plumbing & Heating Contractors Ltd
business.shortDescription: Gas Safe registered plumbing, heating, and bathroom specialists delivering premium boiler installations, emergency repairs, bespoke bathroom renovations, power flushing, and underfloor heating across Greater Manchester and North Cheshire.
business.description: Vanguard Plumbing & Heating was founded by lead heating engineer Thomas Vance in 2011. We are a tightly knit, highly skilled team of local Gas Safe engineers, master tilers, and system designers — never subcontractors. We combine the bulletproof technical standards of a national firm with the deep care, strict punctuality, and upfront honest pricing of a trusted local family business. Worcester Bosch Diamond Accredited. Vaillant Advance Master. CIPHE & WaterSafe registered.
business.slogan: Premium craftsmanship. Transparent pricing. Guaranteed peace of mind.

stat.headline: Since 2011
stat.sub: 13+ years · Gas Safe registered · 2,000+ jobs completed

reviews._comment: Reviews stay disabled by default (DMCC Act 2024 — no fabricated ratings). Set enabled:true and fill aggregate/platforms ONLY with real, publicly visible reviews.

services.name: Boiler Installation & Heating Upgrades
services.summary: Premium ErP A-rated condensing boiler installations with 12-year manufacturer warranties. Worcester Bosch Diamond & Vaillant Advance accredited.

services.name: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.summary: 24/7 rapid-response emergency plumbing with thermal imaging leak detection. Under-60-minute average arrival across Greater Manchester.

services.name: Luxury Bathroom Design & Renovation
services.summary: Complete turn-key bathroom transformations — 3D CAD design, in-house tilers, plumbers, and electricians. No subcontractors, single point of accountability.

services.name: Gas Safety Certificates & Boiler Servicing
services.summary: Landlord CP12 certificates and deep 15-point annual boiler servicing. Instant digital certification, lifetime reminder scheduling.

services.name: Power Flushing & System Deep Clean
services.summary: Industrial-grade Kamco power flushing with magnetic filtration. Restores radiator output, silences noisy boilers, and extends system lifespan without replacement.

services.name: Underfloor Heating Design & Installation
services.summary: Bespoke wet underfloor heating systems — overlay retrofit and in-screed new-build. Room-by-room BS EN 12831 heat loss design by in-house engineers.
